Problem 8: Asymmetric Catalytic Synthesis of Thiochromenes (8 points, 8%)
On 2016-9-26, researchers from Washington University published a study on the asymmetric catalytic synthesis of thiochromenes. Thiochromenes are sulfur-containing heterocycles. This reaction is highly stereospecific, meaning that the configuration of the chiral carbon bonded to the R group in the product is determined. Stereochemistry is not required in this problem; the SMILES or structural formulas in your answer need not specify the configuration of chiral carbons, alkenes, or other stereochemical features.

subquestions.text_open: 8.1 Give the SMILES structures of the key intermediates and the reaction product. Hint: the product contains a fused six-membered/six-membered ring system.
